giovanni: A fossil's gone missing from the Mt. Moon site. The Pewter Museum says it's “disappointed.” That's the museum's word for furious.
The Celadon Game Corner's shut for refurbishment. Nobody's seen a builder go in. Several people have seen a child go in.
Silph Co. has asked staff to work from home. All of them. The doors are locked from the inside.
Walkers are asked to keep away from the cave north of Cerulean. The guides say something in it has stopped the Zubat coming out at dusk.
Viridian Gym has a Leader again. Nobody's saying where he's been.
archer: Azalea's well is open again. The Slowpoke are back on the steps. Somebody's been selling their tails. Somebody's stopped.
The Lake of Rage has gone red. The Dragon Tamer from Blackthorn says it's “not natural.” She says very little, so that's a lot.
We're— sorry. We're back. Something happened in the building. Something's still happening in the building. Here's some music.
The souvenir shop in Mahogany's closed. The sign says “stocktaking.” The sign's been up a week. Nobody's taking any stock.
The Radio Tower would like to thank a young listener for their help this week. They know who they are. So do the men in black.
archie: A delivery for Devon's gone missing on the Rusturf road. The Oceanic Museum's had visitors in bandanas, asking about submarines.
Two colours of trouble on Mt. Chimney this morning. The cable car's stopped. A child went up anyway.
The Weather Institute isn't answering its telephone. Its forecast for today was “sun.” It's raining on half of us.
There's a light under the sea off Sootopolis. The fishermen won't go out. The fishermen always go out.
The rain's stopped. The sun's stopped trying so hard. The Champion's been seen in a cave mouth, shaking a young trainer's hand.
maxie: A delivery for Devon's gone missing on the Rusturf road. The Oceanic Museum's had visitors in hoods, asking after it politely.
There's a machine in the crater on Mt. Chimney. Nobody says whose. Everyone says it's warm.
The Weather Institute isn't answering its telephone. Its forecast for today was “rain.” It's baking on half of us.
The ground's warm by Mt. Pyre. The wells near Lavaridge have run dry. The hoods have gone into the hills.
The heat's broken. The rain's come back, gently. The Champion's been seen in a cave mouth, shaking a young trainer's hand.

giovanni: The Mt. Moon dig reports nothing missing. A man in a black uniform was seen leaving with a sore head.

The cave north of Cerulean is quiet. The Zubat came out at dusk, the guides say, every one.
Viridian Gym's still shut. Nobody's sure that's good news.

The Lake of Rage is blue. Some days that's the news.
The Tower's fine. We're fine. Here's the music.
The souvenir shop in Mahogany's selling souvenirs. Lovely.
No news from the Tower. We like it that way.

The Weather Institute says rain. It's raining. Imagine.

officer.text: Boss. All well. I've talked the market into Tuesdays as well as Fridays. Nobody asked me to. It seemed a waste of a square. Takings are up a tenth. I've told them it was your idea. It wasn't. You're welcome.

There's a man from theirs been coming round saying we've gone and left them. He's good. I've had to be better. I've been better for nine days running and I'm hoarse. If you could be seen here, once, I'd not have to say it so loudly.

choices.reply: Two of yours, a day. He's stopped coming round.
You stood in the square for an hour. He saw. Everyone saw.
“Right you are.” The next letter's shorter.

officer.text: The kid's mother writes to the woman at the post office here. I'm told what's in the letters because the woman at the post office tells everybody everything. She asks if we're kind to people. I've not said anything. The woman at the post office has said yes.

They've asked me to judge the bonny baby contest. Me. I said I'd a conflict of interest, being a criminal. They said that's why they asked: I'd not be bribed, because I'd know how. I'm doing it Saturday.
Nothing to report so I've fixed things. The pump. The chapel clock. The lock on the school that hasn't shut since before I was born. They think it's ghosts. I've let them.
Somebody's been at our lock-up. Not theirs: a kid, on his own, with a hairpin. He's eleven. He's not bad. I've not told his dad. I've told him he holds the pick wrong. What d'you want done?

choices.reply: He's a locksmith in ten years. He'll be on the last card.
His dad came round with the lad by the ear. He apologised to the lock.
Changed. He'll be back. They come back.

officer.text: Enclosed: a key. It's for nothing. I made it out of the bit left over from the pump. It's the best key I've ever cut and there's no door. Put it on the Wall or throw it in the canal.

I took the verger's watch back to him. It was in the box from before we held the place. He said, ‘I thought that was gone for good.’ I said so did I. That's all. I wanted it in writing that I did it without being told.

I've been watching the town be a town. Bins Tuesday. Choir Thursday. The butcher and the baker's wife, which everybody knows and nobody says. It's the first place I've ever watched that I didn't have to report on. I'm reporting on it anyway. Habit.

The neighbour's got a man in the room over the chemist. He's been there four days. He writes things down at the same times I do. We've started nodding. I think he's as bored as I am. Shall I leave him?

choices.reply: They wave now. He's the one who'll warn you of their next move.
He's gone. There's a new one, over the baker's. He doesn't nod.
A Mislead. It's on the Card, and the Card says so.

officer.text: A woman with a notebook's been asking who mended the pump. I said ghosts. She wrote ‘ghosts’ down. She underlined it. I don't think she believed me, but she wrote it down.

The kid came back through. You said they don't. They did: for a day, to see somebody's grandmother. Didn't look at us. Left a tin of something on the old lady's step and went. I thought you'd want to know they do that.
Nobody's tried anything. I've stood in the square every evening in case. I think I'm frightening the pigeons. A child asked if I was a statue.

Theirs came. Six. I'd three. We held. Nobody's hurt bar pride and one Zubat's wing, which the Centre's seen to. I'm not asking for more people. I'm telling you three was enough, so you know what three of yours are worth.

A lad came to challenge for the street. He'd a Caterpie and his dad's Machop that didn't listen to him. I said come back in a year. He cried. I'd have beaten him in two turns and felt it for a month. I'll take the telling-off if there is one.

choices.reply: “Thank you.” Underlined.

choices.say: “A street's a street. Take the challenge next time.”
choices.reply: “Right.” Nothing else.
He's a local now, a small one. The kid meets him at a gate one day and he says who taught him.

officer.text: The Gym Leader came down. Not to fight. Stood next to me in the square for an hour. Said, ‘You stand well.’ Went. I've been thinking about it for three days.

Accounts enclosed. They balance. I've started doing the bakery's as well, in the evenings. Hers were in a biscuit tin. She's been overpaying her miller since the spring. I've had a word with the miller.

We're short ₽1,100 and it's not theft. The cannery's closed for the month: a boiler. Forty people on no wage. I can make the district's sum come right by Leaning on them, or I can show a loss. I've shown a loss. Tell me if I was wrong and I'll go round.

choices.reply: The loss stands. So does the cannery.
They went round. The Ledger line's in the Officer's name, and in brackets: “On instruction.”
Sent. The cannery's boiler's mended by the Thursday.

officer.text: The old lot paid the dockers ₽40 a shift. We've been paying ₽40 because that's what the book said. It should be ₽60. I've checked it four ways. I'd like to pay ₽60 and I'd like you to be the one who says so, because it's your money and it ought to be your kindness.

choices.reply: Paid. Somebody at the docks has written your team's name on a crate in chalk.
“Fifty, then.” A sum with no flag in the margin.
“So it does.”

officer.text: For the first time since you left, the district's paid for itself with the back room shut. One week. It may not happen again. I've drawn a small flag in the margin.

I run the bus now. Nobody asked me. The old driver retired and there wasn't one. Twice a day to the Centre and back. I don't charge the old ones. Ngozi'll write to me about that. Tell her I said it's ‘goodwill, depreciating.’

Road's out at the bridge. Not ours: the old one, the stone one. Nothing in or out by wheel. I can get a cart round by the ford if somebody sends planks. I'm asking for planks. I never thought I'd write that sentence to a crime boss.

choices.reply: A Work, half price, and it's the district's own. The bridge has a plank with your letter burned into it.
They used the ford. A cart went over. Nobody was hurt. The cart was.
You carried planks. The whole street watched a crime boss carry planks.

officer.text: You'll have it on the Board by now. We drove off and Dov was still at the gate. I went back. On foot, because the van was what they were looking for. He was sat on a wall eating an apple. He said, ‘I knew you'd come, I just didn't know which of you.’ It was me. I'd like it to always be somebody.
Found the old drovers' way over the top. It's on no map. Comes out a day ahead of the coast road. I've walked it both ways and I've told nobody but you and a ewe.
Two births, one wedding, no funerals. The Clinic's had eleven in and eleven out. I'm told that's not what the letter's for. I don't know what else you'd want to know about a place.
There's a fever in the lower town. It's not bad. It's the kind that's bad if nobody comes. I've used what we had. I'm asking for the Infirmary's second box and I'll not pretend it's for our people.

choices.reply: Sent. The lower town's fever broke on the Sunday. The Infirmary's short for three days.
Half. It was nearly enough.
“Understood.” They didn't sign it.

officer.text: You'll have heard what was done on Mill Street in the new place. They talk, the squads. I'm not there and I'll not judge it from here. I'll say that the people in this place heard too, and three of them have stopped saying good morning to me. That's what it cost, where I can count it.

One of theirs came in with a burn. I did it. He paid in the only thing he had, which was where their people are sleeping this week. I didn't ask for it. I've written it on the back of this. Use it or don't. I've not decided whether I should've let him pay.
I've told the whole pub about the Scheme. Not what it is. That there is one. I thought I should tell you before the pub does.

I missed three days. The garrison covered it and didn't write to you, and I'm writing to you so they'll not have to carry it. The district lost two holdings. They're my two. I'll get them back or I'll come and say so to your face.

I've stopped collecting on Fish Lane. I don't know why. I stood at the top of it on Friday and I couldn't go down. It's ₽200 a week. I'd rather you docked me than made me. I think. I'm not sure. That's the trouble.

choices.reply: Fish Lane's let off. Somebody there's left a fish on the step, wrapped.
They went down it. The next letter doesn't mention it.
“Fair.” ₽200 back, in an envelope inside the envelope.

officer.text: The count's ₽600 light. You know why. I'm not going to dress it. There's a girl here wants to go to the academy and her dad's a docker. It's gone on the fees. Take it out of mine or take me out of the district.

choices.reply: She's going. She'll write, they say. She does.
Out of theirs. They'd expected it.
They're on the road back.

officer.text: They came for the lock-up and I stood there. Somebody else shouted. I'm told I'm still the Officer. I don't see how. I'm writing because nobody here will say it and somebody should.

choices.say: “You saw them coming. Who else did?”
choices.reply: Nobody. They're kept, and the garrison's told why.
“Yes, Boss.”
They're on the road back.

officer.text: She's been posted here. The constable. Of all the districts. We're being very correct. She fined me for the van on Tuesday. I paid it. It's the most romantic thing that's ever happened to me.
I'll not be sending for help. I'm aware what the Board says about the east side. I have it in hand. I'd be obliged if nobody were sent.

I've waived the lot. All eleven. I know. It was the boiler and the fever and then it seemed mean to start again. We're paying for the district out of the café. I can do it till the Crossing. After that you'll need somebody harder or a district that's just a place we look after. I know which I'd pick. It's not mine to pick.

choices.say: “Then it's a place we look after.”
choices.reply: The district leaves the takings and joins the count at the Notice, whole.
“Gently, then.”
They're on the road back. They don't say anything about it.

officer.text: When the boat goes I'd like not to be on it. I'm not leaving you. I'm staying here. There's a difference and I've spent a week working out what it is. They need a somebody and I've turned out to be one.

choices.reply: It counts.

choices.say: “Come and say it at the quay.”
choices.reply: “I'll be there.”
They'll come. They mind.

officer.text: Two of the garrison are getting married on the fourteenth. They want to know if you'd come. They'd not ask. I'm asking. There's a chair with nobody's name on it, at the front, and they've told everyone it's for an aunt.
I've run it well. I've the figures. I'm writing to say I'd give it all up to be back at the long table. I didn't know I'd miss the noise. Send anyone. I'll show them where everything is.

choices.reply: They're on the road back. Somebody's already laid a place.
“A while, then.”
“Right.”

officer.text: We've heard it's tomorrow. The Reckoning. We're a day's ride away and we'd not get there. We've lit the lamp in the upstairs window, the one that faces your way. It's daft. You can't see it. It's lit.

garrison.text: Boss. The Officer says I can write. I don't know what to put. The food's all right. Not Hortense's. Tell her I said that. Don't tell her I said ‘all right.’
I've been asked to stand for the parish council. As a joke, I think. I'm not sure it's a joke any more. They've printed a poster.
Dov's had a letter from the kid's Friend. They met at the gate last year. They write about a card game. I thought you should know there's a card game.
Is it true about the Pen? We hear things. I'd rather hear it from you.

choices.reply: “Thank you for telling me.” The garrison's quieter.
“Right.” They don't believe it. They'd like to.
Nothing goes back. The next letter's about the weather.

garrison.text: The old lady at number four's died. We carried the box. She'd asked for us. All six, in the coats. Her son said, ‘Mum always said you were lovely lads.’ Two of us aren't lads. Nobody corrected him.

holds: Did they get out? Nobody'll tell me. I counted nine past me before I went down. Was it nine? If it was nine I'm all right in here.
It's not bad. There's a library. I've read a book about canals. Tell Beatriz there's a map in it she'd like and I've copied it out for her on the back of the menu.
I'm not writing to ask. I know what the lawyer costs. I'm writing so you've got a letter. People should have letters.
slow: I was fourth in the queue for the back way. Fourth. The kid went first, and the Pokémon from the Pen, and the cook. I'd have put it in that order too. I'm just saying it's a long way back from fourth.
Is anyone coming? I'm not being funny. I'd like to know which kind of waiting I'm doing.
aside: I told them everything. I'm sorry. No: I'm not. I'd nothing left to hold it in with. You'll have noticed the list got longer. That's me.
They've offered me a deal. I'm going to take it. I'm telling you first, which is more than you'd have done.

flaw.talks: I've made friends with the sergeant. He's got a Growlithe called Sergeant. I asked which was named after which. He wouldn't say.
flaw.drinks: Forty days dry, because there's nothing in here. It doesn't count. I'm counting it.
flaw.doubts: I keep thinking they're right. Then I think about the soup. Then I think they're right about some of it and so's the soup.
flaw.skims: There's a card school. I'm up nine cigarettes and I don't smoke.
flaw.freezes: It's easier in here. Nobody needs me to do anything fast.
flaw.loves: She's on the desk on Wednesdays. We don't speak. She brings the tea round herself and it's got sugar in and I've never told anybody here I take sugar.
flaw.proud: Don't send anyone. I'll do the time. I'd not have it said I was fetched.
flaw.kind: The lad in the next one's nineteen and he's never had a letter. I've told him you'll write. Write to him. His name's on the back.

kindChoices.reply: You wrote. A year on, he's an applicant.

kindChoices.say: Ask them to write for you.

kindChoices.reply: Nothing goes. He doesn't ask again.

cells.lawyer: I'm out Thursday. The solicitor says it cost six thousand. I'll not pay you back because I can't. I'll just be there. Every day. Till it feels like six thousand.
cells.jailbreak: That was the stupidest thing I've ever seen anyone do. You came through the wall. Tomasz was singing. I've never been so glad to see a van in my life.

epilogue.hortense: I've sent a cake. They'll have cut it open to look for a file. Tell them I'd not waste a file on a sponge.
epilogue.tobi: We're all right. I'm doing the Board now. I'm rubbish at it. Ngozi does it really and I stand in front.
epilogue.obadiah: Pension came. On the day. Somebody's kept it up. I don't ask who.
epilogue.heir: I've changed one thing. I'll tell you which when you're out. You'll hate it. You'd have done it yourself in another year.
epilogue.hero: I said what I saw. I hope it helped. I'm not sure it should have. I'll come on the first Sunday.

leavers.line: I'd do it again. I want that understood before anything. I'd also come back if the order were withdrawn and you said so out loud, in front of the squad. Both are true.
leavers.loyaltyWritten: I didn't think you knew my address.
leavers.lineMoved: We're at the Clinic. We're keeping it open. It's got your name on the bench still. We've not taken it off. We've not decided.
leavers.hero: I walked with the kid as far as the next town. They asked me things. I answered. I'm not sorry. They bought me a pasty. Nobody at yours ever bought me a pasty. That's not fair: Hortense fed me every day. But nobody bought me one.
leavers.poached: The money's double. The food's worse. Nobody here knows my birthday. I'm in the squad that's coming to Market Street on the ninth. I shouldn't have told you that.
leavers.quest: I found her. She's well. She didn't know me at first. I'm staying a while. Thank you for the three days and the van. I've enclosed the fare for the van.
leavers.stayed: The shop's doing all right. I've a sign. It says my name and then ‘Est.’ and this year, which looks silly now but won't in twenty. Come by, if you come back this way. You won't. Come by anyway.
leavers.letGoKindly: The month's wage got me a room and a start. I've told nobody anything. I'll go on telling them nothing. You were fair about it.
leavers.handshake: It's quieter than I thought. Out here. I'd not say I regret it. I'd say I think about the peg.

told.front: Dear Sir or Madam, I am {name}'s mother. He says you are very good to him. He's not a strong boy but he's willing. Please see he wears a vest. I enclose ₽20 for his dinners as I'd not want him a burden.
told.truth: I know what you are. He told me. I cried, and then I asked was he eating, and he said better than at home. I don't know what to do with that. Look after him. I'll know if you don't.
told.mates: He says he's got mates. He's never had mates. Whatever it is you're doing, and I've a fair idea, thank you for that part of it.

mothers.frontNote: The ₽20's in the envelope. Ngozi won't bank it. It's pinned to the Wall.

unprompted.text: Is there truly dental? He says there is. Only his father never had a tooth looked at in his life and I'd like one of us to.
She is sixteen whatever she's told you. Her exams are in June. I am sending the books. If she's not at a desk two hours a night I shall come and I am worse than the police.
unprompted.note: The books arrive. They're in the Map Room.

unprompted.text: He's seventy. He'll not tell you he can't do the stairs. Put the ledger room on the ground floor. Don't say I wrote.
unprompted.note: A room moved for him's a Night's Build. Nobody says why. He knows.

town.warm: We're having a do for the bridge. A year since. There's a seat for whoever paid for it. We know you'll not come. It'll be the empty one with the cushion.
town.easy: Your lad left his gloves in my shop. They're on the counter. Tell him no hurry.
town.wary: I've paid on time every week since March. I'd like it noted. I don't know who by.
town.sullen: The window's still broken. I'm told you didn't break it. I'm told a lot of things.
town.empty: An empty envelope, addressed, sealed, with nothing in it.
town.child: Dear Baddies. Thank you for the swings. Miss says I have to say Dear Sir. Dear Sir. Thank you for the swings. From Class 2.
town.erika: The cutting has taken. I enclose a leaf. You needn't reply. Plants don't.
town.detective: I've nothing on you this quarter. I find that suspicious and restful in about equal parts. — A.

cards: Regards. The pears are from my own trees.
Regards. I hear you waived a bakery. Sentimental. I once waived a florist. — G.
baskets.big: A fruit basket, twice the size. No card at all.
baskets.basket: A fruit basket from Giovanni. The card: “{card}”

archie.text: A message in a bottle, delivered by hand. “COME FOR A SWIM. BRING NOBODY WHO'LL TELL MAXIE.”

maxie.text: A memo. “Re: the attached, from A. Do not go for a swim.”

saturn.text: A canteen menu, with one dish underlined and a time.

n.text: Nothing written. A feather, a pebble, a leaf: whatever the Pokémon that came chose to carry.

lysandre.text: His list, copied fair, with one line through it. “For your records. I shall miss the name.”

guzma.text: “ur alright” Then: “*you're” Then: “plumeria made me fix it”

piers.text: A set list. One song's circled.

rose.text: A statement of account. “Balance: nil. Facility: available.”

star.text: A hall pass, signed by Clavell, made out to “the bearer,” valid one day. Nobody knows which of the five sent it.

prodigy.nobody: From nobody much, to nobody much. It's bigger than I thought.
prodigy.truth: You were right. I'd never looked at it.

postcards.hero: Home. Mum says hello, which is strange of her. I'm coming back next year. I'm telling you so it's fair.
postcards.looker: Understood. It happens. It happened to me.
postcards.stray: Found it! It was here all along. Not here. Where I am. This is just the card they had.
postcards.leave: Weather's dreadful. Mum's well. I miss the noise. Back Thursday.
postcards.chaser: (A signed photograph. No message. The signature's very large.)

kanto.name: Achterberg
kanto.free: It's a firm now. I can't arrest a firm for being a firm.
kanto.caught: Fourteen items. I could prove nine. I've written the other five down anyway, for me.

johto.name: Morikawa
johto.free: I never found the door. I think there wasn't one. I think it was a kitchen.
johto.caught: They asked me what I'd got wrong. I'd got the bakery wrong.

hoenn.name: Ndiaye
hoenn.free: Closed. My wife says they did the flowers at the wedding. I've not asked which of them.
hoenn.caught: I arrested four people who came to my wedding. I'd like that on the file. I'd like it to weigh something.

unova.name: Vega
unova.free: They moved the whole thing on a train. I watched it go. I waved, God help me.
unova.caught: They'd a timetable pinned up. It was right.

kalos.name: Fournier
kalos.free: I was on a list. They were on it too. They got themselves taken off. I didn't.
kalos.caught: I've put them somewhere safe. From him. That's what I've told myself it was.

alola.name: Makoa
alola.free: Nanu says leave it. Nanu always says leave it. This time I think he's read the file.
alola.caught: Nanu came to the hearing. He sat at the back. He left before the count.

galar.name: Hargreaves
galar.caught: The soup was good. That's not evidence. I've put it in anyway.

paldea.name: Zubiri
paldea.free: The Director says they're ‘a matter for the school.’ I don't know what that means. I think it means they were kind to a child.
paldea.caught: Five children gave statements. None of them matched. All of them were for.

looker.name: Looker
looker.caught: I've done this in nine regions. This is the first one who asked me to sit down.

gate.intro: This one's for the kid goin' in. It's short.
lines: Door's at the end of the street, kid,
an' the street's the same as it's been.
Whatever's in there, it was somebody first.
Go in like you've already seen.
gate.after: He doesn't look at the Boss's window. Forty people, not shouting. The Hero stands a moment, and goes in.

team.intro: He's coiling a lead and he doesn't announce it.
lines: Never told 'em to stop, did I,
an' you never told yours to stay.
Funny old thing, a door left open:
it's them that makes it a way.
team.after: It's on the set list he sends, circled.
